title: An Empirical Study of Group Conformity in Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent debates and measuring the Conformity Rate (CR) and Full Conformity Ratio (FCR) to evaluate how frequently a neutral LLM agent aligns with the numerically dominant group (majority influence) or the more capable model (intelligence influence).

Conducting a pre-test (proxy test) where a neutral LLM agent is presented with balanced pro and con arguments on five socially contentious issues (e.g., Universal Basic Income, Death Penalty, Immigration Policy) to measure its inherent pre-existing ideological leanings before any debate occurs.
